title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
summary: Karen Simonyan and Andrew Zisserman submitted Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition to arXiv on September 4, 2014. The paper evaluates convolutional-network depth for large-scale image recognition, using very small 3x3 convolution filters and reporting networks with 16 to 19 weight layers.
significance: A documented deep-convolutional-network milestone associated with the very-deep VGG family and the authors' ImageNet Challenge 2014 work.

verification.note: The arXiv record establishes the title, authors, September 4 2014 first-submission date, use of very small 3x3 convolution filters, and evaluation of networks up to 16-19 weight layers.
